errors.temporary: Something went wrong. Check your connection and try again.

signIn.title: Sign in or create an account
signIn.subtitle: Enter your email address and we'll send you a link to sign in. No password to remember.
signIn.emailInvalid: Enter an email address in the form name@example.com.
signIn.checkBody: If {{email}} can receive it, we've sent a sign-in link. Open it on this device to continue.
signIn.checkFootnote: The link expires shortly and works once. We'll never ask you for it.
signIn.pasteHint: If the link won't open, paste the code from the email here.
signIn.recovery: I can't get into my account
signIn.linkExpired: That link has expired or has already been used. Ask for a new one.
signIn.linkOpening: Checking the secure link you opened.
signIn.usePhone: Sign in with a phone number

recovery.title: Recover your account
recovery.subtitle: We'll email {{email}} a recovery link. Using it signs you out everywhere else on purpose — if someone else has your account, this is what removes them.
recovery.sent: If that address can receive it, a recovery link is on its way.

invitation.title: You've been invited
invitation.signInFirstBody: Sign in with the address this invitation was sent to, and we'll bring you straight back here.
invitation.wrongAccountTitle: This invitation is for a different address
invitation.wrongAccountBody: It was sent to {{email}}. You're signed in as {{current}}. Sign in with the invited address, or ask {{organization}} to send a new invitation to the address you use.
invitation.wrongAccountAction: Sign in with a different account
invitation.expiredBody: Ask {{organization}} to send you a new one. Nothing has been added to your account.
invitation.usedTitle: This invitation has already been used
invitation.usedBody: If that was you, {{organization}} is already on your account. If it wasn't, contact them before continuing.
invitation.revokedBody: {{organization}} withdrew it. Ask them to send a new one if you still need access.
invitation.alreadyMemberBody: Nothing to do — your work services are on the Home tab.
invitation.invalidBody: The link may be incomplete. Open it again from the original message, or ask for a new one.
invitation.acceptedBody: Any services they assign to you will appear on Home and My Line.

home.noServiceTitle: You don't have a service yet
home.noServiceBody: Choose a plan to get data, calling, or both. Calling over the internet works without an eSIM.
home.pendingTitle: Your order is being set up
home.pendingBody: We've got your payment. Setting up a line with the network usually takes a few minutes — you don't need to keep the app open.
home.pendingFootnote: We'll tell you as soon as it's ready.
home.installTitle: One step left: install your eSIM
home.installBody: Your line is ready. Install the profile on this phone to start using it.
home.failedTitle: We couldn't set up this order
home.failedBody: You have not been left without a route out — check the order for what happened and what to do next.
home.expiredBody: Its allowance is no longer available. Buying a new plan takes a minute.
home.suspendedBody: It stops carrying traffic until it's topped up.
home.loadError: We couldn't load your services just now.
home.unavailableBody: Check your connection and try again. Your account has not been changed.

plans.title: Plans
plans.loadErrorTitle: We couldn't load the plans just now.
plans.noMarketBody: We aren't selling in any country yet. Nothing is wrong with your account — there's simply nothing to buy until a market opens.
plans.noPlansBody: This market has no plans on sale. Try another one, or check back shortly.
plans.deviceIncapable: We couldn't confirm that this phone ({{model}}) can take an eSIM. Our check isn't definitive. Look for an EID in Settings, or dial *#06# — if you see one, your phone can take an eSIM.
plans.deviceCustomerConfirmed: You've confirmed this phone takes an eSIM. We'll go by that.
plans.lockGuidance: We can't tell whether your phone is locked to a carrier — no phone reports it. If you bought it on a contract, ask that carrier to unlock it before you buy.
plans.callsNone: No call rates published for this plan
plans.numberNone: No phone number is included with this plan.
plans.numberNewAssigned: A new {{type}} number is assigned when your line is set up.
plans.numberNewAssignedIn: A new {{type}} number in {{country}} is assigned when your line is set up.

unavailable.no_verified_supplier: We don't have a verified supplier for this plan yet, so we can't sell it.
unavailable.supplier_capability_mismatch: No supplier can deliver everything this plan includes.
unavailable.coverage_unavailable: We don't have verified network coverage for this plan yet.
unavailable.device_rule_missing: This plan's device requirements haven't been recorded yet.
unavailable.device_not_checked: This plan needs an eSIM. Confirm your phone can take one before buying.
unavailable.device_not_esim_capable: This phone can't take an eSIM, so this plan wouldn't work on it.
unavailable.device_locked: This plan needs a phone that isn't locked to another carrier.
unavailable.allowance_missing: What this plan includes hasn't been published yet, so we can't sell it.
unavailable.unknown: This plan isn't available to buy right now. Contact support if you need it.

review.title: Review your order
review.taxUndecided: No tax has been applied. This is not a claim that none is due — our tax treatment isn't settled yet.
review.expiresIn: This price is held for another {{minutes}} min.
review.expiresSoon: This price expires in under a minute.
review.cardOnly: Card payment. Apple Pay and Google Pay aren't available yet.
review.collectionBlocked: We can't take payment yet — there's no live payment account for this seller and currency. You can review the price, but nothing can be charged.
review.expiredBody: Prices are held for a short time so what you see is what you pay. Nothing has been charged. Getting a fresh price takes a second.

order.title: Your order
order.loadingBody: We're fetching what happened to it.
order.openPaymentError: We couldn't open the payment page. Your order is safe — try paying again to reopen the same payment session.
order.declinedBody: Nothing has been charged. Your order is still here — you can try paying for it again.
order.unpaidBody: We've held your order at the price you were quoted. It isn't set up until it's paid.
order.confirmingBody: You've been to the payment page and we haven't had the confirmation yet. This usually takes seconds. Don't pay again — if the payment went through, this order is the one it belongs to.
order.confirmingFootnote: You can close the app. We'll finish this without it.
order.provisioningTitle: Paid — we're setting up your service
order.provisioningBody: We've got your payment. Setting up a line with the network usually takes a few minutes.
order.provisioningFootnote: You don't need to keep the app open.
order.unknownBody: We asked the network to set up your line and haven't had a clear answer. We're checking the original request rather than sending a second one, so you won't be charged twice or given two lines.
order.provisioningFailedTitle: We couldn't set up this order
order.provisioningFailedBody: Your payment is recorded and this is on us to fix. Nothing here needs buying again.
order.refundedBody: The money has gone back to how you paid. Nothing is active from this order.
order.readyBody: Everything on this order is set up. My Line has your number, your installation and your usage.

placeholder.myLineBody: Your number, installation and usage arrive with the line and installation work.
placeholder.accountBody: Receipts, support and account settings arrive with the account work.
placeholder.owner: Assigned to chunk {{chunk}} — not built yet.
